---
title: "Check the DietSwap selection"
---

Confirm that sample IDs match the count table, feature IDs match taxonomy, and the selected samples answer the question. Review repeated participant IDs and missing group labels.

Use the [DietSwap command](../../01-run-the-workflow.qmd#dietswap). Its automatic checks validate the table structure. Confirm the participant and time-point selection yourself.
